subject: Draft MAP + collaborative workshop: AtlasHealth evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Richards <sam.richards@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + collaborative workshop: AtlasHealth evaluation timeline

Hi Sam —

Great to meet earlier this week. Based on our call, I sketched an initial mutual action plan to keep the evaluation tight and measurable. The edit link below is a living doc — feel free to co-edit directly. Key pieces I added: 30-day pilot acceptance criteria, API throughput targets to validate, and a week0 checklist for security and data handling.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bMAP-template-Atlas-EDIT
Attachment: MAP_Template_v2.gdoc (stub)

Proposed next steps:
- You and your engineering lead add any missing acceptance criteria by Tues 7/3
- Co-edit session (30–45m) to finalize roles + test plan: Wed 7/4 10:00am PT (I can send a calendar invite)
- Redwood will provide: sandbox access, sample dataset guidance, and basic throughput benchmarks for our standard dedup/kv cache config

Before the co-edit I want to make sure we include the compliance evidence you asked about — Jordan, can you paste the SOC2 audit snapshot and the typical retention window note into the doc?

Sam — if the timing above works, I’ll lock the invite and we’ll add a short agenda (objectives, success criteria, test owners, timeline).

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

On Fri, Jul 1, 2028 at 9:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great to meet earlier this week. Based on our call, I sketched an initial mutual action plan to keep the evaluation tight and measurable.

Thanks Naomi — nice start. I added two short sections in the doc:
- "Performance validation" (target token/sec, p95 latency target under the sample dataset)
- "Security checklist" (SOC2 link + minimal evidence we can bring into a secure file share)

I attached a small image for the week0 acceptance grid — helps set the demo expectations. Also recommended we avoid committing to specific quantization steps in the MAP; better to list them as optional optimization milestones (post-pilot).

I’ll paste the SOC2 snapshot into the doc and link the secure evidence folder (DocShare link) once Naomi confirms the region and expected retention windows.

Jordan

From: Sam Richards <sam.richards@atlashealth.com>

Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + collaborative workshop: AtlasHealth evaluation timeline

Thanks Naomi — this looks promising. A few quick asks from our side before the co-edit session:

1) Can you add a short line under "success criteria" that says "validated throughput >= 1k tokens/sec for our 512-token average payload"? That’s the minimum number our infra team will need to consider integration.
2) Procurement needs a preliminary T&C checklist (license type, data handling summary) — I’m looping them on this thread.
3) Security: we can receive SOC2 evidence via a secure share; please include the DocShare link in the MAP and a one-paragraph note about retention and encryption-at-rest.

Wed 7/4 at 10am PT works for a 30m focused session. If possible, please invite the solutions architect who will own the sandbox (Jordan — thanks for jumping in).

Sam Richards
Director of Platform Engineering, AtlasHealth
sam.richards@atlashealth.com
+1 617-555-0899

Perfect — thanks Sam. I updated the doc with your throughput line and added the procurement checklist stub (license + data flow summary). Jordan pasted the SOC2 snapshot and I added a DocShare link under Security > Evidence.

Confirmed: co-edit workshop Wed 7/4, 10:00–10:30am PT. Calendar invite sent. Agenda (short):
- 5m objectives + success criteria (Naomi)
- 10m performance validation plan + data prep (Jordan + Atlas eng)
- 10m security/compliance handoff + evidence path (Marissa)
- 5m clear owners & next steps to pilot start

Prework request for Atlas: drop a short sample payload (anonymized) into the doc or link a sample file in the shared Drive by Tue 7/3 EOD so Jordan can sketch throughput expectations before the call.

Final note: I attached the MAP template and the week0 acceptance grid image to this thread for quick reference.

See you Wednesday —
Naomi
